answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Accredited documentary researcher log with broadcast archive certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 479 fakes spends 7664 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The vertex test is the live device, the lantern test is the locked stake, and the pigment test is the graded history no template can fake. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
